_comment: Deliberate, reviewed differences between the baseline and a migration target. Anything not listed here fails. Each entry is a human decision with a reason, never a way to silence a failure. The first three are known limits of the suite itself (all targets). The rest are Part 2's static archive (target static), made by retire/run.sh. One Part 2 decision has no entry because no check observes it: retire/prep/20-disable-google-analytics.sh removes the Google Analytics script from every page (owner's decision, 2026-10-23; a page may refer to fewer external URLs than the original).

entries.regex: ^(.*[Ff]eel free to email|Send us an email at) \.$
entries.reason: Suite limit, not a site change: an e-mail address written by document.write() (node 3804 and the 'feel free to email' line on 19 listing and teaser pages). The HTML baseline records the line with a hole; a real browser shows the filled-in address, so the line never matches in the visible tier. Semantic still requires the line. No tier checks the address itself (DISCOVERIES.md).

Suite limit, not a site change: the tripinfo_item prev / Up / next pager is three <a> elements with no whitespace between them. The HTML extractor reads one run-together line; Drupal's book CSS shows three lines, so the visible tier never finds it whole. Semantic still requires the line and all three links. Kit gap: the extractor should split adjacent block-styled links (DISCOVERIES.md).

Suite limit, not a site change: the audio module prints a live download counter (audio.download_count) on the 10 podcast nodes and the /audio and /podcast listings, and every request to /audio/download/N/... adds one, including the suite's own asset check. The number cannot be frozen. The 'N downloads' line must still exist; its value is not compared. Pristine values are in DISCOVERIES.md.

An archive has no unpublished pages: the 81 paths of the 41 unpublished nodes answer 404 instead of Drupal's 403. Equally private. Only 403 -> 404 is allowed; a private page that leaks (403 -> 200) still fails, and a Drupal 11 target is still held to 403.

Home page only: retire/prep/10-remove-search-pane.sh removes the Search pane (heading 'Search' and the site's only form) from the home page's Panel, because search cannot work on a static site (Lullabot retirement series, part 1).

Uploaded pre-Drupal gallery page: its one link to the production domain, http://hobobiker.com/, is made relative (/) by rewrite-static.mjs so the archive does not depend on that domain. Exact text replacement; every other byte is the original's (20 bytes shorter).

Uploaded pre-Drupal gallery page: its one link to the production domain, http://hobobiker.com/mexico/, is made relative (/mexico/) by rewrite-static.mjs so the archive does not depend on that domain. Exact text replacement; every other byte is the original's (20 bytes shorter).
As mexico/trippics/Page.html: one own-domain link made relative, nothing else changed.
